newsitem.title: FRANCE: Algerian Moslem rebels kill eight, including baby.
newsitem.headline: Algerian Moslem rebels kill eight, including baby.

text.p: Suspected Moslem fundamentalists killed eight people, including a 13-month-old baby, in a night attack outside Algiers, the country's security forces said on Friday.
In a statement, security officials said the eight were "assassinated in a cowardly way" -- the term Algeria usually uses for killings where the victims have their throats cut.
"This barbarous act did not exclude a baby of 13 months who was strangled by the criminals," said the statement, carried on the official Algerian news agency APS.
The attack took place in the farming community of Sidi Kaddour in Sidi Moussa district, in Blida province, during the night of Wednesday-Thursday.

The provincial capital Blida, some 50 km (30 miles) south of Algiers, is both the headquarters of the Algiers military district and a known stronghold of Moslem fundamentalists who have been trying for five years to topple the Algerian authorities.
